summary: Frontend test (Playwright, 1920x1080) of CM Operational Automation Phase 2, Stage 1 and Stage 2. I used the cm.aftersales (ASM), cm.coordinator and cm.finance accounts with fictional TEST_p2ui_ data, and the real AI extraction. 1 real bug: in the Build Quote UI, clicking Save a second time creates a second, different quote. 2 medium gaps. Everything else passed. TERMS: the 2026-01-28 .docx row shows 'Word reference copy (not issued)' with 'Download Word' and no Approve or Needs review button. I uploaded the test PDF TEST-p2ui-1 and it showed 'Awaiting internal approval'. Approve stayed disabled (title 'Open the PDF first') until View PDF was clicked, then it worked: 'Approved for customer issue', and the status line named TEST-p2ui-1. Needs review opened the reason input and the button changed to 'Confirm review'. Confirming set 'Requires review — <reason>' and the status line went back to 'No approved terms'. The test PDF was then deleted, so only the original .docx remains. FINANCE on a signed agreement: none of these appear: generate, send, record signature, activate, revoke, resend, retry, welcome resend or reissue, payment, start date, DD or wording controls. The terms card is not shown. 'Issued agreement' opens the PDF in a new tab. RETRY STORAGE (coordinator): the red afs-ag-signed-doc-failed banner and Retry storage button appear. Clicking it gave the toast 'Signed PDF stored — contract activated'. Status became Active, the button became 'Signed agreement', and steps 0-6 completed. WELCOME PACK labels (welcome_pack forced to each state via route interception): blocked shows '· on hold' and 'Welcome pack on hold — Signed agreement attachment unavailable…' with Resend. accepted_by_provider shows 'accepted by email provider (delivery not yet confirmed)'. delivered shows 'delivered'. failed shows 'not delivered' with Resend. The real run was 'not delivered — Email provider did not accept the message' (expected in preview). BUILD QUOTE import: the three doc types are offered. From the sales invoice it read 6 lines, including reference SI-P2UI-8812 and its date. The customer was recognised by account reference. The flags were correct: exact code auto-accepted, Price provisional, Unknown code, Spare part / accessory (auto-excluded), Several variants (review) and Already under contract (auto-excluded, '1 on register'). Use in Build Quote stayed disabled while '2 line(s) need a decision' and while no site was chosen. 'Find machine…' listed LED and Touch, and choosing Touch set the line to accepted. Apply gave the toast '4 machine(s) ready to price (0 already on the register, 4 added)'. The prefill banner read 'From sales invoice SI-P2UI-8812 — TEST_Harbourview Leisure Trust: 4 confirmed machine(s) pre-selected.' Build Quote then worked and showed the PROVISIONAL exception. Re-uploading the same PDF gave 'This document was already imported — showing the saved result'. After use it showed 'Already used for quote AFS-…' with apply disabled. The unpriced quote shows '4 unpriced — edit to send', and Record acceptance, Send to customer and Create link are all disabled. Maintenance invoice: the evidence-only note appeared, with flags 'Invoice price is evidence only' and 'Serials ≠ quantity'. An unknown customer showed 'not confidently identified — choose'.

minor.issue: For a line flagged variant_review, decision='accepted' with no config_id is accepted. It silently uses the first candidate (e.g. the LED console instead of Touch). It should return 400 for variant_review lines unless config_id is given.

ui_bugs.component: AutoQuoteTab build() / Save as draft quote
ui_bugs.issue: Saving twice does not reuse the quote. The first Save (with prefill) created AFS-2026-50EBA with source=document_import and source_import_id. build() then calls clearPrefill(), so the second click on 'Save as draft quote' (still visible, same result) posts without asset_ids or source_import_id. That created a second quote, AFS-2026-AECFC: source=auto_estate, source_import_id null, whole estate, extra ALREADY_COVERED exception. No 'reused' toast was shown. Reproduce: import an invoice → Use in Build Quote → Build → Save → Save.

The 'Select customer…' list comes only from /crm/v2/companies?limit=200 and has no search. The operator org has 704 companies, so most customers (including the seeded TEST_ one) cannot be picked when the document's customer is not recognised.

A 'Several variants — choose one' line has its Match column already showing the first variant ('TEST_P2Cross / LED · exact product code'). The 'Include' option is enabled because ln.matched exists, so a user can include it without choosing a variant.

issues: The health card says 'Contract Ready' and 'Activate Contract' is still shown next to the red 'activation is on hold' banner. Clicking Activate would only hit a 409. Consider hiding or disabling Activate while signed_document_error is set.
The Start date fields (afs-ag-start, afs-ag-edit-start) still use the browser's own date picker (mm/dd/yyyy). This is not new in this phase, and the design was asked to stay unchanged.

action_items: Fix the duplicate on second save in AutoQuoteTab: keep source_import_id and asset_ids for the current result after save (for example store them in result state or a ref), or disable or hide Save once result.saved_quote_id is set. Do not let a later save fall back to a whole-estate auto_estate quote.
Add a server-side search (type-ahead) to the import customer picker instead of the 200-item capped companies list.

For variant_review lines, disable 'Include' until a variant is chosen via Find machine…, show the match as 'choose variant' instead of the first candidate, and make /apply reject accepted without config_id.
critical_code_review_comments: AftersalesApp.js is 3435 lines. Split DocumentImportCard, TermsCard, AgreementProgress and AgreementsTab into separate modules.
build() in AutoQuoteTab has no .catch: API errors give no toast (unhandled promise rejection).
TermsCard shows only data.terms.slice(0, 4), so older versions (including a superseded or approved one) can be hidden with no 'show all'.

The TermsCard 'opened' state lasts for the session: after 'Requires review', Approve is enabled again straight away without opening the PDF again. The backend accepts any past inspection. Consider requiring a fresh view after a review flag.

All removed: seed cleanup, plus terms id 71a33df0 and crm2_notifications for PF-MA-6E5851. Only the original 2026-01-28 .docx (reference_only) remains in crm2_afs_terms, and no test PDF is approved. The stored objects (test terms PDF and agreement PDFs in object storage) were not deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Seed with: cd /app/backend && python tests/_clear_login_ratelimit.py && python tests/_seed_cm_phase2_ui.py seed. Cleanup: python tests/_seed_cm_phase2_ui.py cleanup. The agreement seed has no approved terms, so set a real document with storage_path (see /tmp/fixdoc.py idea: compose_pdf(ag, None, 1) then _put). Otherwise /agreements/{id}/document raises KeyError 'storage_path', which is a seed artifact only. Create the invoice PDFs with reportlab (_pdf in the seed writes /tmp/TEST_p2ui_invoice.pdf). Login is at /login with gx-login-email, gx-login-password and gx-login-submit, then wait for /launch and go to /contract-management. Tabs are text in crm-tabs-bar ('Build Quote', 'Contracts'), then afs-tab-agreements. ASM account = cm.aftersales@pulsefitness.test (there is no cm.asm). Retest: Save twice should reuse the quote; the variant line should need an explicit choice; the customer picker should search all companies.
